definitions.short: Naamah , the name of an antediluvian woman, of an Ammonitess, and of a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H5279. Na 'amah I. נַעֲמָה proper name, feminine 1. sister of Tubal Cain Gen 4:22 ᵐ5 Νοεμα , ᵐ5 L Νοεμμα . 2 Ammonitess, mother of Rehoboam 1Kin 14:21 ᵐ5 Μααχαμ , A Νααμα , ᵐ5 L Ναανα = 2Chr 12:13 , ᵐ5 Νοομμα , ᵐ5 L Νααμα ; also 1Kin 14:31 but probably gloss (omitted by ᵐ5 B , ᵐ5 L , etc.). II. נַעֲמָה proper name, of a location city assigned to Judah in Philistine plain Josh 15:41 ; ᵐ5 Νωμαν , A Νωμα , ᵐ5 L Νομα . נַעֲמִי see below
